title: IP Insights from SMEs and Startups in Germany
content: IP Insights from SMEs and Startups in Germany, part of the “Innovation and Business Growth Series”, explores how Intellectual Property Rights (IPR)-intensive SMEs use and perceive intellectual property. Using a combined quantitative and qualitative approach, the study identifies barriers to IP uptake and provides actionable, evidence-based insights to help the national IP office develop tailored support services that foster innovation and business growth among SMEs and startups.
